articles.title: UK Heatwave Breaks a Record — And It’s Not Over Yet!
articles.summary: England is baking in its third heatwave this year, and Thursday’s temperature hit 35.1°C in Surrey. That breaks the record for the most 34°C+ days in a year! Health alerts now cover almost all of England, and trains are slowing down because the tracks might buckle.

articles.title: Olympian Says He Just Touched the Water — Now He’s in Court!
articles.summary: David Hearn, a former Olympic canoeist, pleaded not guilty to damaging the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool. He says he only touched the water out of curiosity. But prosecutors say he caused over $1,000 in damage to the newly renovated pool. Supporters cheered him outside court!

articles.title: Trump’s Giant Arch Plan Hits a Speed Bump: Too Tall for Washington’s Rules!
articles.summary: President Trump wants to build a 250-foot arch near the Lincoln Memorial, but planners say it might break height rules. The arch would be more than twice as tall as the Lincoln Memorial!
